appearances.title: Local-model agent benchmark by VRAM tier: a 12 GB card clears 27 of 30 Hermes Agent tasks, 32 GB clears all 30
appearances.summary: A 30-task offline agent suite in Hermes Agent (multi-file renames, merge conflicts, git bisect, fixing bugs behind a 40-test suite) picks the best quantized model for each GPU memory size at 64K context. Spark-X2.6-4B gets 25/30 on 8 GB, Ornith 1.5 9B 27/30 on 12 GB, and Qwen3.8-27B reaches 29/30 at Q4_K_M and 30/30 at Q6_K, with tool-call counts and wall times reported.

appearances.title: Activation probe catches gpt-oss-20b planning to misuse a token before it acts
appearances.summary: A builder rebuilt a USC method (Oct 12 paper) that reads agent activations to flag bad intent. On a local RTX 5090, gpt-oss-20b scored 1.39 against a 1.09 alarm line just before passing a secret token in a command, while later telling the user it lacked authorization. Report and code are on GitHub.

appearances.title: Hermes Agent at about 93 tok/s on one RTX 5090 with Qwen3.8-27B and MTP drafting
appearances.summary: A builder ran Hermes Agent for an hour on a local Qwen3.8-27B 6-bit file in llama.cpp with the model's MTP draft on, a q8_0 KV cache and 128k context: about 93 tok/s over 297,736 generated tokens (93 to 97 across five runs) and 2,100 to 2,200 tok/s prompt reads. 128k context uses 27.0 of 31.8 GiB; 192k fits, the full 262k does not.

appearances.title: Ornith 1.5 on one RTX 5090: 35B Q4 at 303 tok/s nearly matches the 3-bit 122B
appearances.summary: Local benchmark on one 32 GB RTX 5090: the 122B 3-bit file (46.1 GiB) runs at 47.6 tok/s with some experts offloaded to system RAM; the 35B Q4_K_M (20.2 GiB) fits on the card at 303 tok/s. First token on a 16k prompt is about 28 s vs 2 s. GPQA Diamond (thinking on) 83.3 vs 81.8, a tie on 198 questions; MMLU 85.8 vs 82.2 is the one clear 122B win. Full report includes the offload sweep.

appearances.title: Which Qwen3.8-27B quant to run for multi-turn tool calling: 3-bit matches 6-bit
appearances.summary: witcheer tested six files of Qwen3.8-27B on 100 multi-turn tool-calling tasks: 6-bit (22.9 GB) scored 81, 3-bit (11.9 GB) 80, GSQ-RCO 2-bit 76, Ternary-Bonsai 73 and Underdog-Saluki 71. On single-step tool calls all six scored 86 to 90, so the gap only shows over several turns; the advice is 3-bit on a 16 GB card, and keep thinking on for GSQ-RCO.
